changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-apipie-ai` skill for operating APIpie AI through the OOMOL `oo` CLI connector.
- Supports OpenAI-compatible non-streaming chat completions via `create_chat_completion`.
- Supports embedding generation for one or more text inputs via `create_embedding`.
- Provides model discovery through `list_models` and detailed model metadata through `list_detailed_models`.
- Includes built-in guidance for schema inspection, JSON payload execution, credential handling, and first-time setup troubleshooting.
